@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import pytest
+
+from openlibrary.plugins.importapi import code
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    'query,expected',
+    [
+        ({'override-validation': 'true'}, True),
+        ({'override-validation': 'TRUE'}, True),
+        ({'override-validation': 'false'}, False),
+        ({}, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_import_post_forwards_validation_override(monkeypatch, query, expected):
+    edition = {'title': 'Test item', 'source_records': ['test:item']}
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(code, 'can_write', lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(code.web, 'header', lambda *_args: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        code.web,
+        'input',
+        lambda **kwargs: query if kwargs == {'_method': 'get'} else None,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(code.web, 'data', lambda: b'{}')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(code, 'parse_data', lambda _data: (edition, 'json'))
+
+    def load(rec, override_validation=False):
+        calls.append((rec, override_validation))
+        return {'success': True}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(code.add_book, 'load', load)
+
+    assert code.importapi().POST() == '{"success": true}'
+    assert calls == [(edition, expected)]
